name: io.github.StoaDex/stoa
title: Stoa: swaps on Robinhood Chain
description: Swaps, token safety checks, stock-token gaps, Spotlight and Stoa Pay on Robinhood Chain.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Tokens Stoa lists on a network, with address, symbol and decimals, plus the router address. Any other token address can still be quoted, but treat it as unverified and run safety_check first.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Compare every venue Stoa routes for this exact amount and return the route it would fill: amountOut (after Stoa's 2 bps fee), minOut for the slippage, price impact and the venues. Read-only.

sellToken.description: Token to sell: a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

buyToken.description: Token to buy: a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

amount.description: Amount to sell, integer in the sell token's smallest unit (wei). 0.01 ETH = 10000000000000000.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default 50 (0.5%).

tools.name: build_swap
tools.description: Same as quote, plus the unsigned transaction (to, data, value, chainId) for the taker's wallet to sign, and the approval it needs first when selling a token. Stoa never signs or sends anything.

sellToken.description: Token to sell: a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

buyToken.description: Token to buy: a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

amount.description: Amount to sell, integer in the sell token's smallest unit (wei).

taker.description: The wallet that signs, pays and receives.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default 50.

referrer.description: Optional wallet that earns 10% of Stoa's fee on this swap.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds until the transaction expires. Default 120.

tools.name: safety_check
tools.description: Simulate a small buy and an immediate sell-back of a token through Stoa's live router (eth_call, nothing sent), and read how concentrated its supply is. Returns verdict ok | caution | danger | unknown, buy and sell tax, round-trip cost, creator and top-10 holdings. A pass describes the token today; its owner can still change the rules.

tools.name: bridge_quote
tools.description: Move ETH, USDC or USDT from Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism or BNB Chain to the same wallet on Robinhood Chain (arriving as ETH or USDG), through LI.FI over Across. Returns an unsigned transaction on the source chain that Stoa has already decoded: receiver and refund address are the wallet, destination is Robinhood Chain, it spends exactly the amount asked. If 'approval' is present, approve exactly that amount first. Regular wallets only.

fromToken.description: ETH, USDC, USDT or USDT0, as available on that chain.

toToken.description: What arrives on Robinhood Chain. Default ETH.

amount.description: Integer amount of fromToken in its smallest unit (18 decimals for ETH and BNB Chain stables, 6 for USDC/USDT elsewhere).

wallet.description: The user's wallet: it signs on the source chain and receives on Robinhood Chain.

tools.name: market_context
tools.description: CoinMarketCap data to put a trade in context: total crypto market cap and 24h change, BTC and ETH prices and dominance, the Fear and Greed index, and for up to 5 Robinhood Chain tokens their price, market cap, liquidity, 24h high/low, volume, trades, buyers and sellers. Use it before suggesting or explaining a trade; use quote for the price a swap actually gets.

tokens.description: Optional. Robinhood Chain token addresses (or symbols from list_tokens, or "native" for ETH). Leave out for the market overview only.

tools.name: stock_tokens
tools.description: Robinhood Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain: Robinhood's price for the underlying stock next to the on-chain price, liquidity, 24h volume and whether Stoa can route a swap. Optionally filter by ticker.

routableOnly.description: Only stocks Stoa can swap right now.

tools.name: stock_gaps
tools.description: Robinhood Stock Tokens whose on-chain price is furthest from Robinhood's own price right now: cheaper or dearer on-chain, among pools with real liquidity that actually trade (pools with under $100 of 24h volume and gaps over 25% are left out as stale). Optionally a 7-day history of one token's gap from Stoa's open dataset. Information, not trading advice; outside US market hours Robinhood's price follows the overnight session.

side.description: cheaper: on-chain below Robinhood; dearer: above. Default any.

historyFor.description: Optional ticker (e.g. TSLA): also return its gap every 6 hours for the last 7 days.

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: Quote one swap on Robinhood Chain on every venue Stoa's router uses (Uniswap V2/V3/V4, Aero, Ramses, Pons curves, Metric pools), each alone and before fees, in the same block, next to what Stoa's own route returns after its 2 bps fee. Shows which venue pays the most for this exact amount and how far the others are. Read-only.

sellToken.description: What you sell: ETH, USDG, STOA, a stock ticker like NVDA, or a 0x address.

amount.description: Amount to sell in whole units, e.g. "1" or "0.25".

tools.name: robinhood_chain_today
tools.description: Robinhood Chain as a whole right now, in one call: 24h DEX volume, liquidity and trades across the pools of every stock token and the 100 most-traded tokens (DexScreener), volume by venue and the top pools, the stock tokens furthest from Robinhood's price, the median gap and stock-token volume over the last days, the live Pons launches that raised the most with Stoa's safety verdict, how far apart venues quote the same swap, and Spotlight, next to the whole crypto market from CoinMarketCap (total market cap and 24h change, BTC and ETH, Fear and Greed). Kept five minutes. Use it for a market overview before going into one token.

tools.name: open_data
tools.description: Stoa's public on-chain data: every swap routed through Stoa (newest first), the Points season 1 board, or the venue-quote basket (the same swaps quoted on every Robinhood Chain venue in one block). Also lists the open datasets on Hugging Face with their download links and checksums.

set.description: datasets (default): where the open data lives; swaps; points; venues.

limit.description: Rows for swaps or points, 1 to 200, default 50.

tools.name: spotlight
tools.description: Stoa Spotlight on Robinhood Chain: projects bid ETH for 3 sponsored slots a week and $STOA holders lock and vote; voters share most of each winning bid. Returns the week, its phase (before_week_1, bids_open, votes_only) and closing times, the rules (quorum, min bid, entry fee), every candidate with its bid, votes, whether it wins if voting closed now, the votes it still needs and the ETH per 1M votes it would pay now, last week's winners and the $STOA locked. Give `token` and `votes` to estimate what that many more votes on that token would earn if it wins (an estimate: bids and votes move until the week closes). Sponsored, not reviewed: run safety_check before buying a Spotlight token.

token.description: Optional: a candidate's token address or symbol, for an estimate.

votes.description: Optional: $STOA votes to add to that token, for the estimate.

tools.name: agent_services
tools.description: Stoa's directory of paid HTTP services for AI agents on Robinhood Chain (data, analysis, execution, content), paid per call in USDG with Stoa Pay. Each is listed by its seller, whose payout wallet has 1M+ $STOA locked on Stoa (read live): stake, not a guarantee; Stoa does not run or check them. Returns name, summary, price per call, endpoint, paid calls so far and the lock.

query.description: Optional words to search names and summaries.

tools.name: buy_agent_service
tools.description: A Stoa Pay request for one call of a listed agent service: to the seller's wallet, for its price, in USDG. Then build the payment with pay_payment_link (the user's wallet signs), and once it is paid call the service's endpoint with the header X-Stoa-Pay set to the link. The seller accepts each paid link once. Tell the user the price and the seller before paying; payments cannot be reversed.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Stoa Pay on Robinhood Chain: a link that asks to be paid `amount` USDG (or that much in a Robinhood stock token) to `to`. Whoever opens it pays with any token Stoa routes, or ETH from Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Ethereum for USDG payouts. Nothing is stored or signed: the link is the request. Returns the URL; check it later with payment_status.

amount.description: Amount in USDG, up to two decimals, e.g. "25" or "12.50". Max 10000.

note.description: Optional plain-text note, up to 80 characters.

receiveAs.description: Optional: a Robinhood stock token (ticker like NVDA, or its address) to be paid in instead of USDG.

tools.name: pay_payment_link
tools.description: The unsigned transaction that pays a Stoa Pay link on Robinhood Chain from `payer`, with `payWith` (a token address or native). The requester gets at least what the link asks, or the transaction does not go through. Stoa never signs or sends: show the user the amount and the recipient, approve first if 'approval' is present, then let the user's wallet sign.

payWith.description: Token to pay with: an address on Robinhood Chain, or native for ETH. Default USDG.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Whether a Stoa Pay link has been paid on Robinhood Chain, read from the chain: the paying transaction, who paid and when.
